method: Prioritization derived strictly from findings in the 9 emitted audit JSONs (security-map, truthfulness-report, registry-map, ai-execution-map, frontend-architecture-map, sector-state-classification, integration-map). No invention.
sequencing_rule: Order = (1) security-critical that changes attacker surface, (2) secrets/credential hygiene, (3) network trust/pinning, (4) authz completeness, (5) frontend duplication/truth, (6) simulated-data removal, (7) enabling the dormant AI stack behind existing honesty guards, (8) dead-registry cleanup, (9) scheduling. Each item lists concrete evidence + exact files.

first_upgrade_sequence.title: Gate system.py host-management endpoints behind authentication + admin
first_upgrade_sequence.evidence: security-map: system.py is UNAUTHENTICATED; imports only ROOT,ai_service,get_store,now_iso (no get_current_user). /system/launch (403 deny-list verified live), /provider-settings (plaintext, 284-296), /processes (psutil), /files, /screenshot, /clipboard, /windows, /dashboard all reachable without a token.
first_upgrade_sequence.action: Add get_current_user dependency + _require_admin to /launch, /provider-settings, /processes, /files, /screenshot, /clipboard, /windows. /dashboard may stay public (read-only platform metadata) but should be rate-limited.
first_upgrade_sequence.risk: Low - adds a gate; /system/dashboard stays live (already verified 200). /launch already deny-lists destructive cmds; this just adds identity.

first_upgrade_sequence.title: Stop plaintext provider settings + remove secret-shape leakage from frontend
first_upgrade_sequence.evidence: security-map credential_flow.provider_settings_plaintext (system.py L284-296 writes openai_api_key etc. unencrypted into misc KV); truthfulness-report frontend_secret_shape_exposure (lib/api.ts L327-339 ProviderApiKeys enum; dashboard/settings/page.tsx placeholders expose sk-...,AKIA...,tvly_... shapes).
first_upgrade_sequence.action: Migrate provider settings to the existing Fernet scheme (connectors/crypto.py) used by the Connector Registry; delete the ProviderApiKeys secret-field-name enum from lib/api.ts; replace settings placeholders with masked, typed fields (no secret shapes).
first_upgrade_sequence.runtime_blockers: ProviderGateway honesty guards expect keys via secrets-manager; reconcile after encryption migration.
first_upgrade_sequence.risk: Medium - changes how provider keys are stored; backend restart required.

first_upgrade_sequence.title: Pin localhost -> 127.0.0.1 in self-callbacks + CORS allowlist
first_upgrade_sequence.evidence: security-map ipv6_localhost_self_callback: system.py:38, connectors/oauth.py:202-203, extensions.py:596 & 922, connectors.py:270, core.py:593 (ollama localhost), core.py:677 CORS [localhost:3000/5173/5003].
first_upgrade_sequence.action: Replace http://localhost:3000 with http://127.0.0.1:3000 in self-callbacks; pin CORS allowlist to 127.0.0.1 + explicit origins; pin OLLAMA base to 127.0.0.1:11434.
first_upgrade_sequence.risk: Low - loopback pinning; verify OAuth redirect still matches registered callback.

first_upgrade_sequence.title: Close RBAC object-level gap + clamp pagination
first_upgrade_sequence.evidence: security-map rbac_object_level_gap: /rbac/users unbounded page param (no upper clamp) -> resource-exhaustion; no per-resource ownership/row-level authz.
first_upgrade_sequence.action: Clamp per_page (1-200); add resource-owner authorization filter; audit-log every RBAC read.

first_upgrade_sequence.title: Collapse frontend 3-way client duplication + 4 duplicated stores + duplicate websocket hooks + duplicated SystemCapability type
first_upgrade_sequence.evidence: frontend-architecture-map: jarvisAPI (lib/api.ts) + apiClient (lib/api-client.ts) + systemApi (features/system/api.ts, thin facade over apiClient); 4 hook names (useSystemStore/useMonitoringStore/useChatStore/useAuthStore) exported from BOTH src/stores/* AND src/features/*/store.ts; duplicated websocket modules lib/websocket.ts vs hooks/useWebSocket.ts; SystemCapability duplicated types.ts:26 + features/system/types.ts:64.
first_upgrade_sequence.action: Pick ONE canonical client (lib/api.ts jarvisAPI), migrate all features/*api.ts facades to it, delete src/stores/* duplicate (keep features/*/store.ts), delete lib/websocket.ts (keep hooks/useWebSocket.ts), merge SystemCapability into a single types module.
first_upgrade_sequence.risk: High - touches ~20+ UI files; do behind feature flag; verify tsc --noEmit = 0 and SystemMonitor still fetches live CAPABILITIES/PLATFORM.

first_upgrade_sequence.title: Migrate ~10 Math.random simulated dashboards to real backend endpoints
first_upgrade_sequence.evidence: truthfulness-report math_random_simulated_data (jarvis-v10-chambers, jarvis-smart-home, analytics-dashboard, supreme, holographic, neural-background, cascade-codeviewer, real-time-monitoring, modern-dashboard-system, omega, knowledge-hub:491, neural-activity-map) - 10 dashboards simulate telemetry.
first_upgrade_sequence.action: Route each simulated widget to /system/dashboard telemetry OR /api/v1/monitoring/metrics; remove Math.random; delete autonomous-state-manager backup_registry stub or persist to backend.
first_upgrade_sequence.risk: Medium - depends on backend telemetry completeness for each metric.

first_upgrade_sequence.title: Configure provider credentials so the dormant AI stack engages behind honesty guards
first_upgrade_sequence.evidence: ai-execution-map: ai_enabled=False, 0 providers configured, 4 tiers reach-able only in code, 5 honesty guards REAL but dormant. core.py ai_service.enabled False.
first_upgrade_sequence.action: After SEC-2 (encryption), set provider keys via the secured store (Phase 6 keys in F:/AI/providers OR JARVIS_BRAIN_ENDPOINT + brain_api_key via secrets-manager) so ai_enabled becomes True and a REAL tier (T2/T3/T4) serves behind the honesty guards. Do NOT bypass honesty guards.
first_upgrade_sequence.risk: High - changes runtime AI behavior; requires a live provider key + restart; verify honesty guard still raises on local-rule/empty.

first_upgrade_sequence.title: Resolve Silverwing backend path mismatch
first_upgrade_sequence.evidence: integration-map/AI-execution: main.py L87 expects ROOT/silverwing-backend; gateway.py L50 expects <jarvis_backend>/silverwing-backend; real Silverwing source at F:/AI root dirs (silverwing, silverwing-runtime, silverwing_120m...). /silverwing/health integrated:false.
first_upgrade_sequence.action: Point main.py + gateway.py at the real Silverwing root (or relocate silverwing-backend), then re-enable integrate_silverwing() mount; verify /silverwing/health integrated:true.
first_upgrade_sequence.risk: Medium - integration surface; verify backend restart (no --reload).

first_upgrade_sequence.title: Retire or wire orphaned / dead registries; begin capability unification
first_upgrade_sequence.evidence: registry-map dead_registries: Device Registry (absent), Plugin Registry (disconnected), APP_REGISTRY (hardcoded frontend-only); convergence #1 'Agent vs Provider vs Capability vs Tool registries are separate and disconnected' (4 distinct, non-converging); convergence #3 four capability notions (system._CAPABILITIES, agents.capabilities, connector ActionSpec capabilities, rbac permissions).
first_upgrade_sequence.action: Either wire Plugin Registry via main.build_app() or delete infrastructure/plugins; make APP_REGISTRY driven by a backend source; establish a single capabilities concept (extend system._CAPABILITIES provenance to be the canonical registry that agents/connectors/rbac reference).
first_upgrade_sequence.risk: Medium - touches registry semantics across 4 components.

first_upgrade_sequence.title: Replace scheduler stub + complete n8n wiring
first_upgrade_sequence.evidence: agents.py:207 {running:true,interval:60,next_run:None} stub; automation._n8n_headers() empty when N8N_API_KEY unset; system.py /system/dashboard automation.scheduler_running=False.
first_upgrade_sequence.action: Implement a real scheduler (replace stub) and gate automation.py n8n behind N8N_API_KEY presence; surface scheduler_running truthfully in /system/dashboard.
first_upgrade_sequence.risk: Medium - adds a background worker path.

non_goals: Discovery only - do NOT implement items during this audit phase (per constraints).
No new features invented; every recommendation is traceable to an emitted finding.
No production file edits in this phase except .jarvis/ diagnostic artifacts.
